comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Dental implants and orthodontics sold to dentists; different customers and procedures than spine and orthopedic surgery.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Neurosurgery, wound and reconstruction devices; little overlap with spinal implants or bone graft orthobiologics.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Single-use interventional and cardiovascular catheters for hospitals; different products and procedures than spine and orthobiologics.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mainly advanced wound care skin substitutes reimbursed by Medicare; only a small musculoskeletal line overlaps with Xtant.
